note: Off-catalogue damage-zone ring 3.0-8.0px from catalogue, one-dot-per-2.8px-cell, 25000 dots; zero catalogue mass; local format-valid only
hypothesis: Blind / off-catalogue faults nucleate in the damage zone around mapped traces (jogs, stepovers, relay ramps), so a catalogue-distance ring emission (3–8 px off trace) recovers faults absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue without mass on mapped faults.
mechanism: Euclidean distance transform from pinned existing_faults.tif catalogue; select footprint pixels at 3–8 px distance that are off catalogue; one-dot-per-cell thinning at 2.8 px; emit {0,1}; budget-capped at 25,000 dots.
named_non_fault_process: Unfaulted lithologic contacts, volcanic flow fronts, alluvial fan toes and relict shoreline scarps produce similar off-trace edge/rugosity signatures and can mimic the ring signal.
evidence_classes: LOCAL-FORMAT-VALIDATION only (values in [0,1], 0 NaN/Inf, CRS/shape/transform match sample_submission.tif, zero dots on catalogue, zero mass outside footprint). No HOLDOUT-DTI measured (training labels unavailable without DrivenData login); no ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED score. A projection is never written as a score.

validator_output.validation_class: local format/range preflight; not organizer acceptance or uniqueness clearance
